items.t: Platelet transfusion, intravenous, 1 unit immediately. · Platelet transfusions are only indicated in acute active bleeding uncontrolled by other means or before procedures.

dosing.h: Annexure 17 WHO Clinical Staging of HIV/Aids for Children, Adolescents and Adults

items.t: (platelets <50,000 cells/µL) · • Unexplained anaemia (<8 g/dL), neutropenia (< 0.5 × 109 per litre) • And/or chronic thrombocytopenia

dosing.h: Women at risk for the development of pre-eclampsia

items.t: Thrombocytopenia (platelet count <100 000/μL). • Impaired liver function (ALT or AST >40 IU/L). • Severe persistent right upper quadrant or epigastric pain.
Platelets, IV, 20 mL/kg, administered immediately and rapidly over 15– 30 minutes through a platelet giving set. 3.2

dosing.h: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura/ Haemolytic Uraemic Syndrome

items.t: Apheresis platelet transfusion, IV, 5–10 mL/kg over 20 minutes.

contraindications.t: TTP and heparin-induced thrombocytopenia unless life-threatening bleeding

cautions.t: Transfuse through a fresh giving set
